dict.string: Tarsy needs to control your browser to manage tabs and navigate pages.

Tarsy runs AI coding agents that need to read and write project files on your Desktop. Without this, agents will fail the moment they touch a file here and you will not be able to approve it while you are away from your Mac.

Tarsy runs AI coding agents that need to read and write project files in Documents. Without this, agents will fail the moment they touch a file here and you will not be able to approve it while you are away from your Mac.

Tarsy runs AI coding agents that need to read files in Downloads (package caches, installers, cloned repos). Without this, agents will fail the moment they touch a file here and you will not be able to approve it while you are away from your Mac.
Tarsy may need to access projects stored on network shares. Without this, agents will fail on network-volume projects and you will not be able to approve it remotely.
Tarsy may need to access projects stored on external drives. Without this, agents will fail on removable-volume projects and you will not be able to approve it remotely.
